|ingredients = {{Name|Common Mushroom|1}}{{Name|Morel|1}}{{Name|Oil|1}} }} '''Fried Mushroom''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Fried Mushroom may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Fried Mushroom can sometimes be purchased for {{Price|2500}} from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. One Fried Mushroom may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Sandy |love=George |dislike=Harvey,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Fried Mushroom is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Fried Mushroom is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]].
